sources.title: UR5 Pick and Place - GitHub
sources.snippet: The robot is able to pick up a bottle from a table and place it on another table (and also give the dummy a drink 😁 🍺). The computer vision part of the project is implemented via a CNN. The CNN is trained to detect the bottle position on the image.
